title: Forjate UseCase contract
description: Declarative contract for an ephemeral use-case environment. Consumed by scripts/ephemeral/ephemeral.sh and by AI agents that need to discover the environment without probing it. See docs/ephemeral-use-cases.md.

name.description: Identity of the use case. Must equal the directory name under k8s/overlays/usecases/ — CI asserts this.

description.description: One-line summary, used in the use-case catalog.

isolation.description: shared: a namespace on the reused forjate-uc-shared cluster. dedicated: its own k3d cluster — mandatory when the use case installs CRDs, operators or StorageClasses.

ttl.description: How long before gc reclaims the environment.

components.description: Catalog components this use case pulls in, relative to k8s/components/. Informational: reviewers and the catalog read it, the runner does not.

jobs.description: The lifecycle. Executed in order: seed, run, verify.

seed.description: Loads fixtures the use case needs to be meaningful.

run.description: Optional. The use case's actual work — the mechanism-agnostic slot.

verify.description: Proves the environment does what it claims. `up` blocks on this one.

outputs.description: The agent-facing contract: what this environment exposes once it is up.

name.description: Role of this endpoint within the use case, e.g. source or target.

service.description: Kubernetes Service name. The in-cluster address is <service>.uc-<usecase>.svc.cluster.local:<port>.

protocol.description: Wire protocol hint for clients, e.g. postgresql, mongodb, amqp, http.

name.description: Role of these credentials, e.g. source-credentials.

secretRef.description: Name of the Kubernetes Secret in the use-case namespace.

keys.description: Keys the consumer should expect inside that Secret.

name.description: Name of a Job in the built overlay manifest. CI asserts it exists.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for completion before giving up.
